verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents self-hosting the complete platform within your own infrastructure (Docker, Kubernetes/Helm), which gives "full control over your data" and so lets users decide where data lives. However, nothing in the evidence shows a region or residency choice for the hosted SaaS offering. missing for 10: documented region selection for hosted SaaS (e.g. EU/US data centres), an explicit data-residency guarantee or policy, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Self-hosting Flagsmith allows you to run the complete Flagsmith platform within your own infrastructure, giving you full control over your data, security policies, and deployment environment.
Kubernetes and OpenShift: Full Kubernetes deployment with Helm charts and operators
